privacy.metaDescription: How TheOpenLearn collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use our service.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TheOpenLearn helps you turn learning materials into structured roadmaps. This policy describes how we handle personal information in connection with the website, application, and related features (the Service). By using the Service, you acknowledge this policy.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body:
Account and identity: If you sign in, authentication is provided by our identity provider (for example Clerk), which may process your email, name, profile image, and security-related data according to their own policies.

Learning content: You may submit URLs, text, files, or notes so we can generate learning plans, tasks, and related content. That material is processed to operate the Service.

Usage and diagnostics: We may collect technical and usage data such as device type, browser, approximate region, feature usage, and error logs to keep the Service reliable and secure.

Community features: If you opt in to community or visibility features, we may store preferences and aggregate or profile information you choose to display.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body:
We use information to provide, maintain, and improve the Service (including AI-assisted generation), personalize your experience, communicate with you about the product, enforce our terms, comply with law, and protect users and the platform.

We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: AI processing and providers
sections.body: To generate roadmaps and learning assistance, content you submit may be sent to third-party AI and infrastructure providers. Those transfers are limited to what is needed to fulfill your request and operate the Service. Providers are expected to process data under their agreements and applicable law. Do not submit highly sensitive personal data (such as medical records or government identifiers) unless you accept the associated risk.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: We and our vendors may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies for session management, preferences, security, and analytics. You can adjust browser settings to limit some technologies; parts of the Service may not work correctly if you do.

sections.title: Retention, security, and your choices
sections.body:
We retain information as long as needed to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. We apply reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect data; no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure.

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export certain personal data, or to object to or restrict certain processing. You can often exercise choices through your account or by contacting us. You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.title: International transfers and changes
sections.body: We may process information in countries other than where you live. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards. We may update this policy from time to time; the updated date will appear at the top. Continued use after changes means you accept the revised policy to the extent permitted by law.

terms.metaDescription: Rules and conditions for using TheOpenLearn.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern access to and use of TheOpenLearn. By creating an account, accessing the site, or using our features, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

sections.title: The Service
sections.body: TheOpenLearn offers tools to organize learning, including AI-generated roadmaps, tasks, progress tracking, gamification, and optional community comparisons. The Service is intended for personal learning and productivity. It is not a school, university, employer, or professional advisor. Output may be incorrect or incomplete; you are responsible for how you use it.

sections.title: Accounts and eligibility
sections.body: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials confidential. You are responsible for activity under your account. You must be old enough to enter a binding agreement in your jurisdiction (and at least the age required by your local laws for data processing where applicable). Third-party login services apply their own terms.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body:
You retain rights to content you submit. You grant TheOpenLearn and its subprocessors a non-exclusive license to host, process, reproduce, adapt, and display that content only as needed to operate, improve, and promote the Service (for example generating tasks, showing your dashboard, and securing the platform). You represent that you have the rights to submit the material and that it does not violate law or third-party rights.

We may remove content or suspend access where we reasonably believe there is abuse, risk, or a legal obligation.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You will not misuse the Service: no illegal activity, harassment, malware, attempts to break security, scraping or automation that harms performance, redistribution of the Service or its outputs to compete with us, or use that infringes intellectual property. We may investigate and take action including termination.

sections.title: Disclaimers and limitation of liability
sections.body:
THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE." TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, WE DISCLAIM IMPLIED WARRANTIES INCLUDING MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. WE DO NOT WARRANT THAT THE SERVICE OR AI OUTPUT WILL BE ACCURATE, ERROR-FREE, OR UNINTERRUPTED.

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, THEOPENLEARN AND ITS DEVELOPERS WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR ANY LOSS OF PROFITS, DATA, OR GOODWILL. OUR AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR CLAIMS RELATING TO THE SERVICE WILL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF AMOUNTS YOU PAID US IN THE TWELVE MONTHS BEFORE THE CLAIM OR FIFTY EUROS (€50), UNLESS APPLICABLE LAW REQUIRES OTHERWISE.

sections.title: Changes, governing law, and contact
sections.body:
We may modify these Terms or the Service. We will post updates here where practicable; continued use can constitute acceptance. If you do not agree, stop using the Service. Unless otherwise required by law, disputes will be interpreted under the laws of the jurisdiction where the Service operator is established, without regard to conflict-of-law rules.

You can reach us through the contact options published with the Service. For account deletion or data questions, use in-product controls where available.

Meta.title: TheOpenLearn — AI learning journeys
Meta.description: Turn links, PDFs, or notes into a gamified roadmap with phases, XP, learning coins, referrals, and visible progress as you complete tasks and topics.

hero.kicker: From your material to a journey
hero.title: Learn anything with a roadmap that feels like a game — not a spreadsheet.
hero.subtitle: Drop in a link, PDF, or notes. We interpret your goal, confirm the plan with you, then unlock phased tasks, checkpoints, and achievements.
hero.coinTeaser: On the free plan you get starter coins for new journeys, earn the most when you complete an entire roadmap (plus topic milestones), get a monthly top-up, and share referral codes.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Paste a URL, upload a PDF (structure ready), or write raw text — plus a short note on what “done” means for you.
how.step2Body: We summarize subject, scope, difficulty, language, and depth. You edit and approve before anything is generated.
how.step3Body: Phases unlock in order. Each task has resources, checkpoints, XP, and achievements. On the free tier you also earn coins as you complete topics and the full roadmap.

structured.title: Structured by design
structured.body: Phases, tasks, references, and checkpoints keep big topics approachable.

ai.title: Thoughtful AI
ai.body: No surprise wall of tasks — we align on intent first, then generate.

progress.title: Visible momentum
progress.body: Progress, streaks, and a clear coin balance for free accounts — you always see what you have finished and what is next.

rewards.title: Learning coins & rewards
rewards.subtitle: A light game loop keeps motivation honest: spend a little to start a journey, earn it back with quality completions, bonuses for going the extra mile, and monthly + referral top-ups.

starter.title: Starter balance
starter.body: Free accounts start with 50 coins — enough to spin up several roadmaps and feel the loop before you need to earn more.

spend.title: Start a journey
spend.body: Each new roadmap costs 10 coins on the free plan — it keeps generation deliberate and matches real focus time.

earn.title: Earn by finishing
earn.body: Finishing every task in a topic pays 10 coins. Completing the entire roadmap pays 25 coins on the free plan (including a one-time completion bonus). Substantial reflection notes when you finish a task can add 5 more.

monthly.title: Monthly grant
monthly.body: Every calendar month, free learners get +30 coins automatically — a fresh allowance without streak pressure.

referrals.title: Invite friends
referrals.body: Share your code from the dashboard. When someone applies it, you get +30 coins — they still get the full product experience.

moments.title: Milestones that feel real
moments.body: Completing a task, a topic, or the whole roadmap gives you a clear read on what you unlocked and what comes next — not a vague “done” with no context.

gamification.title: Motivation without the noise
gamification.body: Earn XP, collect badges like First Step and Roadmap Finisher, and stack coins when you close phases on the free plan — steady motivation without gimmicks.
gamification.panel: XP reflects depth, badges reflect habits. Every major step — a task, a topic, or the full journey — comes with explicit recognition and a clear next move. On the free plan, coin grants keep the loop rewarding.

i18n.title: Speak your language
i18n.body: TheOpenLearn ships in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Serbian, and Turkish — with more locales easy to add. Your UI and roadmap language setting stays with you.

cta.title: Ready for a calmer way to learn?
cta.body: Create an account, claim your starter coins, and generate your first journey in minutes.

Learn.title: Create learning plan
Learn.subtitle: Tell us what you want to learn and where the material lives. We'll summarize understanding before building your roadmap.
Learn.subtitleNoTitle: Share a link, paste text, or upload a file. We detect topics and suggest titles — you can split one source into several journeys when it mixes unrelated subjects.
Learn.linkNotesHint: Add key quotes or chapter names so the analysis matches what you care about.
Learn.textBodyHint: Chapters, notes, transcripts, or anything you want turned into a roadmap.
Learn.fileTypesHint: PDF (add excerpts below), or .txt / .md (full file is read).
Learn.fileExtraPlaceholder: For PDFs: paste important sections here. For .txt / .md you can leave this empty or add context.
Learn.proposalsDescription: We inferred these from your source. Uncheck any you do not want, edit titles and details, then generate.
Learn.scopeDescription: This source looks like a large topic (for example full official docs). Answer the questions so we match depth and focus to what you actually want. You can go multiple rounds until the model stops asking.
Learn.scopeAnswersPlaceholder: Be specific: goals, timeline, stack, topics to include or skip, and how deep you want to go.
Learn.scopeAligned: Scope updated. Review the journey details below, then generate.
Learn.scopeAnswersRequired: Add your answers before submitting, or use Skip.
Learn.scopeFinishFirstHint: Answer or skip the scope questions first.
Learn.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one journey to create.

errors.linkInvalid: That URL does not look valid.
errors.fileOrTextRequired: Upload a file or paste text.
errors.pdfNeedsExcerpt: For PDFs, paste key excerpts in the text area (full extraction comes later).
errors.invalidJourney: Something is invalid in the journey details — check the fields.
errors.insufficientCoins: You need 10 coins to start a new journey. Complete tasks, finish topics, invite friends, or wait for your monthly grant.

fields.contentLinkHint: Paste a canonical article or docs URL. For MVP, add key excerpts below if you like.
fields.contentPdfHint: Upload is captured in the flow; full text extraction can be plugged in later — add a short description and paste key pages as text for now.
fields.goalHint: Why are you learning this? What would make you say “I nailed it”?

Understanding.title: Confirm understanding
Understanding.description: Edit anything that looks off. When you're happy, we'll generate your roadmap.
Understanding.subject: Subject

Duplicate.title: Looks familiar
Duplicate.body: This is very similar to something you already started. Continue the existing roadmap or create a fresh one anyway.

Roadmap.activeTimeTotal: ~{minutes} min of focused lesson time (~{hours} h) — reading, practice, and self-checks combined.
Roadmap.overviewHint: Jump to a phase in the full view below.
Roadmap.continuationIntro: You completed every task in this journey. Here are AI-suggested follow-ups—each row names which part of this roadmap it extends.
Roadmap.continuationIntroCached: Saved suggestions for this journey (same list as last time). Status updates when you work on a follow-up path.
Roadmap.continuationLoadingHint: This can take a few seconds while we ask the AI for tailored next steps.
Roadmap.continuationErrorHint: If this keeps happening, run `npx prisma generate` and `npx prisma db push`, then restart the dev server.
Roadmap.continuationFootnote: Suggestions are stored on this journey so they stay the same when you come back. Starting a path creates a linked follow-up; status and lesson counts update as you work there (or when you return to this tab).
Roadmap.continuationAlreadyFinished: You already finished this follow-up. Opening it for review.
Roadmap.continuationInsufficientCoins: Not enough coins to start a new journey.

Task.lessonTimeHelp: Typical focused time for this lesson (reading, practice, self-check). Your pace may vary.
Task.guideHint: What to focus on in the resources—not just a link dump. New roadmaps include this by default.
Task.writingsCollapsedHint: Private note or public feed comment — expand to write.
Task.writingsIntro: Private notes stay on your account. An optional feed message can appear in the public feed when your profile is public.
Task.notesPrivateHelp: For your eyes only—reflections, links, and checkpoint work. Longer reflections can still earn bonus coins on the free plan when you complete the lesson.
Task.feedCaptionHelp: Short takeaway others can read next to this lesson in the feed. Only shown if your learner profile is public. Never paste secrets or anything you would not share in public.
Task.feedCaptionPlaceholder: e.g. Finally grokked closures — this exercise clicked when I…
Task.checkpointHintNotQuiz: This is practical help for the lesson above—it is not part of the multiple-choice self-check below.
Task.selfCheckIntro: Short multiple-choice questions on this task. You can retry as many times as you need—we track attempts for learning analytics.
Task.quizSubmitHelp: We record each submission for your progress. Answer every question, then submit.
Task.quizPassed: Perfect — you can finish the task below.
Task.quizQuestionWrong: Question {n}: that option isn’t correct. Correct answer: {correct}
Task.quizErrorInvalid: We couldn’t read your answers. Please try again.
Task.quizAnswerEvery: Choose one option for each question before submitting.
Task.quizErrorInvalidChoice: An answer didn’t match the quiz data. Refresh the page and try again.
Task.quizErrorNotAvailable: This lesson isn’t open for quiz submission right now.
Task.quizErrorNoQuiz: There is no quiz for this lesson.
Task.quizFailed: {correct} of {total} correct. Change the ones that missed and submit again.
Task.quizLegacyNoQuiz: This task has no self-check yet (older roadmap). You can complete it directly.
Task.completeReady: When you are happy with your work, seal the task.
Task.coachCostHint: Each message uses {n} coin on the free plan. Answers use this lesson as context.
Task.coachProHint: Included with Pro — unlimited coach messages for open lessons.
Task.coachLockedHint: Open this lesson on the roadmap to chat with your guide.
Task.coachLockedBody: Finish prerequisite tasks on the roadmap to unlock this coach.
Task.coachEmpty: Stuck on a concept or step? Ask anything about this lesson.
Task.coachPlaceholder: e.g. What does this term mean here? Which resource should I open first?
Task.coachPlaceholderLocked: Unlock this lesson to ask questions.
Task.coachErrorCoins: You need at least one coin to send a message. Earn coins by learning or invite friends.
Task.coachErrorUnavailable: This coach is only available for lessons you can open.
Task.coachErrorInvalid: Could not send that message. Shorten it and try again.
Task.coachErrorFailed: The guide could not answer right now. You were not charged. Try again in a moment.

Achievements.howToFallback: Complete lessons on your active journeys until this badge’s condition is met (see the description above).

howTo.first_step: On your dashboard, open any active learning and complete the next available lesson from start to finish — including the quiz if that lesson has one.
howTo.phase_crusher: Pick one journey and finish every task in a single phase. Work through that phase until each lesson is marked complete.
howTo.consistent_learner: Finish five separate lessons in total. They can be in different journeys; each lesson counts once when you complete it.
howTo.roadmap_finisher: In one journey, complete every lesson in every phase — stay on the same roadmap until nothing is left to finish.

clusterMilestone.once: Complete one lesson whose category is “{cluster}” (each lesson shows a topic tag; analytics use the same buckets). Only lessons on active journeys count.
clusterMilestone.twice: Complete two lessons categorized as “{cluster}” across your active journeys.
clusterMilestone.many: Complete three or more lessons categorized as “{cluster}” across your active journeys.

skillMilestone.once: Complete one lesson that lists “{skill}” in its skill tags on the roadmap or lesson page. Those tags match what you actually practice in that lesson.
skillMilestone.many: Complete three or more lessons tagged with “{skill}”.
